title: 第十一章 不解风情第十二章 关键问题
content_zh:
;;
在今晚之前，四目从未见过秦尧战斗时的血腥场面，更不清楚对方在文才与秋生心中还有一个碎颅狂魔的形象。
他仅知道秦尧的肉身很离谱，即使修为还在人师境界，最多不过人师三重，但在硬碰硬的情况下，就连地师一重的修士都得发怵。
此时此刻，看着胸膛彻底塌陷下去，挣扎着想要跳起来，却根本无能为力的僵尸，他心里满是懊悔：自己怎么就不听劝呢？
“师叔小心。”
战斗之中，瞬息万变。
当他还在为一只僵尸而悲痛失神间，三只僵尸已经突破九叔的封锁，来到他面前。
“我没事儿，师侄莫要动手！”靠着自己身躯单薄的便利，四目疾速挪移，闪开围剿，冲到秦尧身前，抱住他腰身，努力将其推送至堂屋门口的椅子上，怎么都不让他起来。
“嘭，嘭，嘭……”
另一边，九叔倒是打的越来越顺，而听着那一声声的暴打声，四目心疼到不行，大喊道：“师兄，下手轻点，这些可不是外面的野僵尸，全都是我的财神爷。”
九叔翻了个白眼，飞身越过两名高大的僵尸，手如闪电，抹过他们眉心。
“叮叮，叮叮……”眼看一场风波即将化于无形，后院猛地响起阵阵急促的铜铃声，宛如珍珠落玉盘。
“不好，声东击西，这不是一场意外。”九叔脸色剧变，脚踏七星，极速冲向后院。
秦尧拍了拍四目的手臂，示意他放开自己，冷静说道：“文才，秋生，你们两个去取墨斗，罗盘，黄符，铜剑。四目师叔，麻烦你带着这些老哥们，随我一起去支援师父。”
“是。”听他喊的是自己的名字，而不是师兄，文才与秋生尽皆严肃起来，迅速行动。
而在这种氛围下，四目下意识选择了服从，直到跟着秦尧来到后院，看到九叔正在与一只无头飞尸斗法，才堪堪回过神来。
等等……我是师叔，我是长辈啊！
在林九不在的情况下，难道不是应该由我来发号施令吗？
“师叔，僵尸无头为何还能活蹦乱跳？”没给他提出质疑的机会，秦尧见九叔处于上风后就更不急了，伸手指着飞来飞去的无头僵尸道。
“我只听说过无头的刑天可以再战苍穹，从未听说过无头的僵尸还能上天下地。”四目道：“所以说要么是我孤陋寡闻，见的世面太少；要么就是这无头僵尸已经不算是僵尸了，不是傀儡，就是妖魔。”

“师弟，装备都带来了，怎么打？”闲话间，文才和秋生带着大包小包，手中拿着不少物件跑了过来。
秦尧无语，这俩货，一到关键时刻就不开窍：“师父就在这里呢，你们请示我做什么？”
“嘭。”
“救命啊，有蛇，好多蛇！”
倏然，变故突生，原本紧紧关闭着的厢房木门骤然开启，一身蓝衣的任婷婷惊慌失措的从房间内跑了出来，疾冲至无头僵尸面前。
无头僵尸一愣。
九叔满脸愕然。
“淦。”秦尧暗骂一声，第一时间奔跑起来，在无头僵尸反应过来，将魔爪伸向少女白净的脖子时，一脚踹在他半截脖子下方。
哐的一声，无头僵尸一头栽倒，任婷婷吓得眉毛眼睛都快飞起来了，张开双臂冲向秦尧，试图从他这里得到一丝慰藉。

Before tonight, Simu had never seen the bloody scene of Qin Yao's battle, and it was even less clear that the other party still had the image of a skull-crushing madman in the hearts of Wen Cai and Qiu Sheng.
He only knew that Qin Yao's physical body was ridiculous. Even if his cultivation was still at the level of human master, he could only reach the third level of human master at most. But in a head-to-head confrontation, even a monk at the first level of earth master would be frightened.
At this moment, looking at the zombie with his chest completely collapsed and struggling to jump up but unable to do anything, he felt full of regret: Why didn't he listen to the advice?
"Uncle, be careful."
During the battle, everything changes rapidly.
While he was still mourning for a zombie, three zombies had broken through Uncle Jiu's blockade and came to him.
"I'm fine, nephew, please don't do anything!" Relying on the convenience of his thin body, he quickly moved his eyes to avoid the encirclement and suppression, rushed to Qin Yao, hugged his waist, and tried his best to push him to the chair at the door of the hall, without letting him get up.
"Bang, bang, bang..."
On the other side, Uncle Jiu was beating more and more smoothly, and listening to the sound of violent beatings, his eyes were so distressed that he shouted: "Brother, be gentle, these are not wild zombies outside, they are all my God of Wealth."
Uncle Jiu rolled his eyes and flew over the two tall zombies. His hands were like lightning and passed between their brows.
"Ding ding, ding ding..." Seeing that a storm was about to disappear, bursts of rapid copper bells sounded in the backyard, like pearls falling on a jade plate.
"No, it's not an accident. It's not an accident." Uncle Jiu's expression changed drastically, he stepped on Qixing and rushed towards the backyard at high speed.
Qin Yao patted Simu's arm, motioned for him to let go of him, and said calmly: "Wencai, Qiu Sheng, you two go get the ink bucket, compass, yellow talisman, and bronze sword. Uncle Simu, please take these old buddies with me to support the master."
"Yes." Hearing that he was calling his own name, not his senior brother, Wencai and Qiu Sheng both became serious and acted quickly.
In this atmosphere, Simu subconsciously chose to obey. It was not until he followed Qin Yao to the backyard and saw Uncle Jiu fighting with a headless flying corpse that he came to his senses.
Wait... I'm uncle, I'm an elder!
In Lin Jiu's absence, shouldn't I be the one giving the orders?
"Uncle Master, why can a headless zombie still be alive and kicking?" Without giving him a chance to question, Qin Yao became less anxious after seeing that Uncle Jiu had the upper hand, and pointed at the headless zombie flying around.
"I have only heard that the headless Xingtian can fight in the sky again, but I have never heard that a headless zombie can go up to the world." Simu said: "So either I am ignorant and have seen too little of the world; or this headless zombie is no longer a zombie, it is either a puppet or a demon."
"Junior brother, we have brought all the equipment, how can we fight?" During the chat, Wencai and Qiu Sheng ran over with large and small bags and many items in their hands.
Qin Yao was speechless. These two guys would not understand at the critical moment: "Master is here, what do you ask me to do?"
"Bang."
"Help, there are snakes, lots of snakes!"
Suddenly, something unexpected happened. The wooden door of the wing that was originally closed suddenly opened. Ren Tingting, dressed in blue, ran out of the room in panic and rushed to the headless zombie.
The headless zombie was stunned.
Uncle Jiu's face was full of astonishment.
"Gan." Qin Yao cursed secretly and ran immediately. When the headless zombie reacted and stretched its claws towards the girl's fair neck, he kicked half of his neck.
With a bang, the headless zombie fell down. Ren Tingting was so frightened that her eyebrows and eyes almost flew up. She opened her arms and rushed towards Qin Yao, trying to get some comfort from him.
